description.value: Circle K is a 24-hour convenience store and petrol station on Quadra Street in Victoria, part of the international Couche-Tard/Circle K chain. It stocks the standard convenience-store range of snacks, drinks, and packaged foods, and offers coffee on-site. Its round-the-clock hours make it a reliable resupply point for touring cyclists passing through Victoria at any time of day or night.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands at 64m; rack (covered) at 70m; rack (covered) at 71m; rack (covered) at 77m; stands at 96m; stands at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Circle K convenience store (shop=convenience per OSM) open 24 hours at 2635 Quadra Street, Victoria, with phone +12503815675. Listed services are Lottery, Circle K Gift Card, and Coffee — no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycling amenities. Basic groceries are confirmed by the core business classification (convenience store) corroborated by the website. The website title erroneously labels the location as 'United States' despite the clearly Canadian postal code and country code.
concerns: Website page title reads 'Petrol station at 2635 QUADRA STREET, VICTORIA, United States' — country should be Canada. Likely a data error on Circle K's website; the postal code (V8T 4E3) and country code (CA) in the address block correctly identify it as Canada.
OSM survey date is 2017-05-14 — record has not been field-verified in several years; amenities may have changed.
Phone number (+12503815675) comes from the website only; OSM carries no phone field, so cross-check is not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A 24-hour convenience store in Victoria is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists; it meets the Groceries category and its always-open hours add real value to a cycling directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Coffee is listed as a named service on the store locator page, suggesting hot beverages are available, but no broader hot-food programme is mentioned.
